description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring wide flaring solitary cup rises from a narrow pedicel with closely spaced radial septa.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：宽外张单体杯自窄柄升起，杯内放射隔壁密排。

scientific_scope.en: Provisional genus-level reconstruction proposal; the supplied source supports context or partial form, and detailed anatomy remains gated.
scientific_scope.zh: 暂定属级复原方案；来源支持背景或局部形态，详细解剖须通过参考审核。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is wide flaring solitary cup rises from a narrow pedicel with closely spaced radial septa; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以宽外张单体杯自窄柄升起，杯内放射隔壁密排为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish wide flaring solitary cup rises from a narrow pedicel with closely spaced radial septa in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以宽外张单体杯自窄柄升起，杯内放射隔壁密排搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Sources currently support the broader group or partial anatomy; the proposed genus-specific silhouette and period must be checked against an identified specimen or primary figure before production.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: Scleractinia
sources.supports: Solitary cups and colonial scleractinian growth forms; does not verify all proposed genera.
